description: Checks for academic delivery, code quality, and demonstration readiness.

requirements.title: Functional testing
requirements.description: Important expected and invalid paths have been tested.
requirements.why_it_matters: A demo can expose untested interactions quickly.
requirements.consequence: Core features may fail during evaluation.
requirements.action: Create and run a short test checklist covering normal and invalid inputs.

requirements.title: Project documentation
requirements.description: Setup, features, architecture, and usage are documented.
requirements.why_it_matters: Evaluators need to understand and run the work independently.
requirements.consequence: The project may be difficult to assess or reproduce.
requirements.action: Prepare a README with setup instructions, features, screenshots, and limitations.

requirements.title: GitHub repository and version control
requirements.description: The source is backed up with meaningful version history.
requirements.why_it_matters: Version control protects work and demonstrates development practice.
requirements.consequence: Last-minute changes may be hard to recover or submit.
requirements.action: Push the final code to a private or public Git repository and verify it clones.

requirements.title: Deployment verification
requirements.description: The delivered application is opened and checked from a clean session.
requirements.why_it_matters: Local success does not guarantee the deployed project works.
requirements.consequence: The evaluator may see a broken link or missing configuration.
requirements.action: Open the deployed URL in an incognito window and test the primary flow.

requirements.title: Demo preparation
requirements.description: A short, reliable demonstration path and backup materials are ready.
requirements.why_it_matters: A clear demo makes the value of the project visible.
requirements.consequence: The presentation can run out of time or fail to show key work.
requirements.action: Rehearse a 3–5 minute walkthrough and keep screenshots or a recording as backup.

requirements.title: Input validation
requirements.description: User inputs are checked before processing or storage.
requirements.why_it_matters: Unexpected input is a common cause of errors and data problems.
requirements.consequence: Invalid data may cause crashes or confusing results.
requirements.action: Validate required fields, formats, ranges, and server-side input constraints.

requirements.title: Error handling
requirements.description: Expected failures show useful messages and do not expose internals.
requirements.why_it_matters: Failures are inevitable; graceful handling protects the experience.
requirements.consequence: Users may see crashes, blank pages, or unclear failures.
requirements.action: Add error states for network, form, and database failures and test them.
